answer: Reaching the horizon of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on web-of-trust with decaying edges, unlocked only after continuous uptime, no identity may audit its own recruit. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. Each submission hangs on the umber of a task receipt, and the mirror is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short.
